scripts.test:chrome: npm run build:chrome && TARGET_BROWSER=chrome playwright test
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build:firefox && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox playwright test
scripts.test:safari: npm run build:safari && TARGET_BROWSER=safari playwright test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:chrome && npm run test:firefox && npm run test:safari
scripts.build:chrome: npx tsc && rm -rf dist/chrome && webpack --env target=chrome --mode production && cd dist/chrome && mkdir -p ../../release/chrome && rm -f ../../release/chrome/extension-chrome.zip && zip -r ../../release/chrome/extension-chrome.zip .
scripts.build:firefox: npx tsc && rm -rf dist/firefox && webpack --env target=firefox --mode production && cd dist/firefox && mkdir -p ../../release/firefox && rm -f ../../release/firefox/extension-firefox.zip && zip -r ../../release/firefox/extension-firefox.zip .
scripts.build:safari: npx tsc && rm -rf dist/safari && webpack --env target=safari --mode production
scripts.release:safari: npm run build:safari && mkdir -p release/safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-packager dist/safari --project-location release/safari/AlgoRecallSafari --force
scripts.check:isolation:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari && node scripts/check-artifact-isolation.js
